<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/thewarriors/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="The Warriors Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)">

**The Warriors Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)** adds right-stick controls, aspect ratio correction, optional 60 FPS, and faster game loading.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#thewarriors) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix/main.c) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix/memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Ultrawide** — Support ultrawide display ratios with PPSSPP 1.14 and above.

## Options

- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros.
- **Dual analog controls** — Enable right-stick support.
- **60 FPS** — Optional 60 FPS mode.
- **Aspect ratio** — Override the aspect ratio; `auto` uses 16:9 instead of the original 16:10.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.

![PPSSPPWindows64_2022_12_23_16_04_26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4904157/209387701-75952568-fcdf-4a3c-876d-46c8cb38d645.png)

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix/TheWarriors.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game in PPSSPP.
